subject: Phased private-offer: reserved capacity phasing + reseller rebate/onboarding flow
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@datawave.com>, procurement@datawave.com
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Phased private-offer: reserved capacity phasing + reseller rebate/onboarding flow

Hi Aisha / DataWave procurement team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — good alignment on the latency and dedicated pool requirements. Attached is a working MA + pricing workbook (DataWave_MA_plan_v2.xlsx) that encodes the 12-month private offer we discussed and a proposed phased commit:

- Phase 1 (months 0–3): 20% of annual node-hour commit, enable canary nodes + 24/7 on-call for migration support.
- Phase 2 (months 4–8): additional 40% commit; enable reserved instance discounts and KV-cache pre-warming.
- Phase 3 (months 9–12): remainder of commit; apply full rebate rate.

Commercial asks / notes:
1) List price vs committed pricing: the sheet shows list price and the blended committed rate after discounts.
2) Reseller passthrough: ResellCo will handle billing routing; we propose a 7% reseller commission paid as an up-front withheld amount and then true-up monthly against actual usage.
3) Evidence / procurement items: if you can confirm the procurement checklist items (tax ID, billing remit, SOC2 evidence request) we can kick off procurement with Legal and Finance. Team, Connor can provide the rebate flow details and invoice routing options.

Aisha — can you confirm whether DataWave wants invoices to land directly with you (DataWave finance) or via ResellCo for pass-through? Also if you can list any additional evidence required for procurement (e.g., SOC2 attestation, network diagrams) we’ll attach those.

I attached the workbook for numbers. Happy to hop on a short call to walk through the phasing and the reseller cashflow.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0119

Attachment: DataWave_MA_plan_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, pricing by month and sku)

From: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@datawave.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>; procurement@datawave.com
Date: 2027-12-18T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Phased private-offer: reserved capacity phasing + reseller rebate/onboarding flow

Naomi — thanks for the workbook and the clear breakdown. A few quick clarifications from procurement and security before we proceed: 

1) SOC2 + data residency: please share your SOC2 report and a short note on whether any telemetry or logs will touch our EU region or be replicated outside us-east-1.
2) Rebate mechanics: we need a plain-English flow for how the 7% reseller commission is withheld and how the monthly true-up works. Is that withheld from Redwood invoices to ResellCo, or is it a credit applied later? Our accounting needs that mapped to GL codes.
3) Implementation milestone credits: can you confirm whether any onboarding credit reduces the committed baseline or is applied as a separate one-time credit? We prefer credits that do not reduce the committed floor.

Connor — can you send the rebate flow diagram and the recommended invoice routing?

I attached a short procurement checklist for your legal team: DataWave_PO_requirements.pdf.

We can do a 30-minute call tomorrow (Dec 19) if that helps — prefer 10–11am PT.

Thanks,
Aisha Gupta
Head of Procurement, DataWave Inc
aisha.gupta@datawave.com

Attachment: DataWave_PO_requirements.pdf (procurement checklist)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@datawave.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-19T10:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Phased private-offer: reserved capacity phasing + reseller rebate/onboarding flow

Aisha — quick note with the operational flow. See attached diagram (rebate_flow_diagram.png). Summary below in plain language so your accounting folks can map it to GL codes: 

- Invoice path option A (preferred for clean pass-through): Redwood invoices ResellCo (ResellCo is the reseller of record). ResellCo invoices DataWave net of the 7% commission. Redwood records revenue gross; ResellCo records commission expense. Reconciliation happens monthly with a usage true-up sheet.

- Invoice path option B (if DataWave requires direct Redwood invoices): Redwood invoices DataWave gross; Redwood issues a monthly credit note to DataWave for the 7% reseller commission and issues a separate payment to ResellCo. This requires an intercompany / third-party payment flow and is more operationally heavy.

- Monthly true-up mechanics: usage pulls at the invoice cutoff (last day of month). If actual usage > committed rate, the overage is charged at a tethered overage SKU shown in the workbook. If usage < committed, ResellCo and DataWave agree to a carryforward window (2 months) before credits are applied.

- Onboarding credit: we recommend applying a one-time onboarding credit as a separate invoice line (does not reduce committed baseline). That keeps revenue recognition simpler for both parties.

Logistics:
- I can share the SOC2-overview.pdf and a short network flow doc for your security team by EOD.
- If DataWave wants invoices via ResellCo, we’ll need ResellCo’s vendor onboarding form and W-9 (or equivalent).

Quoted for context:
> On 2027-12-18 13:05, Aisha Gupta wrote:
> > Connor — can you send the rebate flow diagram and the recommended invoice routing?

Happy to join the call tomorrow at 10:30am PT if that works.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Director, Deal Operations | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

Attachment: rebate_flow_diagram.png (diagram showing invoice flows and monthly true-up cadence)

From: Kyle Ramos <kyle.ramos@resellco.com>

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Phased private-offer: reserved capacity phasing + reseller rebate/onboarding flow

Hi Naomi / Aisha — Kyle from ResellCo here. Appreciate the loop-in. A few operational points from the reseller side to make onboarding smooth: 

1) Commission handling: we can accept a 7% withheld commission that is reconciled monthly. ResellCo prefers Option A (ResellCo invoices DataWave net-of-commission) to avoid credit notes.
2) Billing & tax: please route the Redwood -> ResellCo invoice to billing@resellco.com and include DataWave’s PO number on the ResellCo invoice. We’ll provide our W-9 and a reseller onboarding packet; attaching our checklist.
3) Ramp plan: ResellCo requests milestone acceptance certificates for Phase 1 canaries (simple form) so we can release first tranche of reseller enablement funds.

Legal: We reviewed the high-level terms. Final agreement pending standard redlines (IP/indemnity/limitation of liability). We can accept the onboarding credit as a separate line item.

Happy to jump on the Dec 19 call recap if you want to include the reseller enablement team.

Best,
Kyle Ramos
VP Channel Sales | ResellCo
kyle.ramos@resellco.com

Attachment: reseller_onboarding_checklist.docx (ResellCo vendor onboarding + required tax docs)
